limitations: Restricted to the two named integer binomial sums and their odd-value supports; no claim about value magnitudes or other transforms. Related count sequences may be catalogued under alternative names. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_integrity: The published Theorems 13-14 supply the input run-length identities. The parity and counting consequences follow from a new explicit word-enumeration argument; the previously indexed pentanacci companion count is acknowledged rather than claimed original. A finite checker is evidence, not proof of the asymptotic theorem.
title: Sharp parity-support separation for two companion binomial transforms
